create_idefics2_processor: create an Idefics2Processor instance with an image processor and tokenizer for multimodal IDEFICS2 model inference
build_multimodal_inputs: build multimodal inputs by passing images and text prompts to the Idefics2Processor __call__ method with image tokens replaced by expanded token sequences
extract_images_from_prompts: extract images from multimodal prompts by scanning prompt elements for valid image objects or HTTP URLs and loading them
configure_image_sequence_length: configure the image sequence length parameter to control the number of <image> tokens per image in the input prompt
add_image_and_utterance_tokens: add special image and end-of-utterance tokens to a tokenizer that does not already have image_token support
